payload.name: lithium (liquid)
payload.structure_source: liquid melted from bcc Li supercell (ASE bulk), density set to 0.4832 g/cm3 at 800 K (Ohse 1985 via Yamdb, arXiv:2402.10922)
payload.rationale: Self-diffusion of liquid Li at 800 K (Tm = 453.7 K), as requested

_fulfilled_need.query: Compute the self-diffusion coefficient of liquid lithium at 800 K. Equilibrate with a thermostat, then use NVE (velocity Verlet) production and check energy drift.

method.engine: NVIDIA ALCHEMI Toolkit (nvalchemi 0.2.0) NVTLangevin + NVE velocity Verlet, cuEquivariance
method.protocol: 250-atom cubic cell at fixed experimental density 0.4832 g/cm3 (Ohse 1985 via Yamdb arXiv:2402.10922); melt 3 ps Langevin 1500 K; Langevin NVT 5 ps at 800 K (friction 0.01/fs); NVE velocity Verlet production 20 ps; D from slope of multi-origin COM-corrected MSD (Einstein relation), fit window 2-10 ps lag; uncertainty from 4 x 5 ps blocks

payload.note: D = 2.18e-4 cm2/s from full-trajectory fit (block values 1.72-2.10e-4, block SEM 0.09e-4). NVE <T> = 797 +/- 29 K. Energy drift check: total-energy drift 1.3e-4 meV/atom/ps, total-energy span 0.016 meV/atom over 20 ps (negligible). MSD log-log slope 1.03 (diffusive). Quoted +/-0.4e-4 covers: statistics (~0.1e-4), uncorrected finite-size effect (Yeh-Hummer correction for L = 18.1 A would raise D by roughly 10-15%; not applied because no sourced viscosity was used), and model error estimated from the validation run (MACE-MP-0 D at 458 K is 5.9e-5 vs 6.8 +/- 0.3e-5 cm2/s NMR at Tm and ~7.5e-5 from the Arrhenius fit, Murday & Cotts, J. Chem. Phys. 48, 4938 (1968); i.e. ~15-20% low before finite-size correction). For comparison, the Murday-Cotts Arrhenius fit D = 0.94e-3 exp(-2300 cal/mol / RT) extrapolated to 800 K gives ~2.2e-4 cm2/s (extrapolation beyond the NMR range; the Murday-Cotts numbers were taken from a search-result abstract summary, the paper itself was not retrieved). Single trajectory, fixed density (no NPT check of model density), PBE-trained universal potential.

summary: lithium (liquid) self_diffusion = 0.00022 cm2/s via NVIDIA ALCHEMI Toolkit (nvalchemi 0.2.0) NVTLangevin + NVE velocity Verlet, cuEquivariance/MACE-MP-0 medium (float32) 250-atom cubic cell at fixed experimental density 0.4832 g/cm3 (Ohse 1985 via Yamdb arXiv:2402.10922); melt 3 ps Langevin 1500 K; Langevin NVT 5 ps at 800 K (friction 0.01/fs); NVE velocity Verlet production 20 ps; D from slope of multi-origin COM-corrected MSD (Einstein relation), fit window 2-10 ps lag; uncertainty from 4 x 5 ps blocks

payload.note: Validation with the same setup (MACE-MP-0, 250 atoms, Langevin melt/equil then 20 ps NVE, dt 1 fs) at 470 K target (NVE <T> = 458 K, density 0.5133 g/cm3): D = 5.9e-5 cm2/s (block SEM 0.3e-5) vs NMR 6.8 +/- 0.3e-5 cm2/s at Tm 453.7 K (Murday & Cotts, J. Chem. Phys. 48, 4938 (1968)). Model ~13% low before finite-size correction, inside the quoted 800 K uncertainty. NVE energy drift: 470 K run -1.8e-4, 800 K run 1.3e-4 meV/atom/ps (pass).
